tiers.CODE-MERGED: Merged code only; never sufficient for a public or live acceptance surface
tiers.CI-GREEN: Merged code plus exact-commit green CI
tiers.BUILD-ONLY: Build succeeded but deployment/live proof is absent
tiers.CAPTURE-ONLY: Captured artifact exists but live status was not verified
tiers.DEPLOY-SKIPPED: Deployment or publication job was explicitly skipped
tiers.LIVE-VERIFIED: Exact PR merge SHA, green CI, non-skipped deploy, and fresh live URL status
